text.hi: बीती बात के लिए क्रिया का दूसरा रूप: win → won, hear → heard, seem → seemed, wait → waited। ‘has’ के बाद तीसरा रूप: has won।
text.hinglish: Beeti baat ke liye kriya ka doosra roop: win → won, hear → heard, seem → seemed, wait → waited. ‘has’ ke baad teesra roop: has won.
text.en: For the past, use the past form: win → won, hear → heard, seem → seemed, wait → waited. After ‘has’, use the third form: has won.

text.hi: Prepositions छोटे शब्द हैं जो जगह या तरीका बताते हैं: on (ऊपर), in (अंदर), into (अंदर की तरफ़ जाते हुए), across (आर-पार), with (के साथ), to (की ओर), by (से, जैसे by bus)।
text.hinglish: Prepositions chhote shabd hain jo jagah ya tareeka bataate hain: on (upar), in (andar), into (andar ki taraf jaate hue), across (aar-paar), with (ke saath), to (ki or), by (se, jaise by bus).
text.en: Prepositions are small words for place or way: on, in, into, across, with, to, by (as in by bus).
